resources.string: Your identity, kept in your hands. Choose how you can return to your conversations.

Know who you are talking to. Keep this conversation on your terms.
Compare every group with your contact through a trusted channel before marking this conversation verified.
Session reset and blocking are not implemented in this beta. These controls will appear when they work.
Open a conversation to view its safety number and privacy controls.
Keep useful copies. Make room for what comes next.
A wider network, with clear boundaries.
Gateway forwarding is not connected in this beta. These settings save your policy only; they do not relay Internet traffic yet.
Remember your choice for gateway support. No Internet traffic is relayed in this build.
When gateway transport is available, it will relay encrypted envelopes and may use battery and data. This build saves your preference only.
Allow mobile data when gateway transport becomes available? Your saved daily cap will still apply.
Policy limit from the OMCP core. Live gateway usage is not measured in this build.
Relay storage is not implemented in this beta. Your own queued messages still wait for a direct mesh connection.
